title: fix: C_Initialize and C_Finalize do not reject non-NULL pReserved
description:
pkcs11test Init.InitArgsBadReserved and PKCS11Test.FailedTermination confirm:
- C_Initialize with init_args.pReserved != NULL returns CKR_OK (should be CKR_ARGUMENTS_BAD)
- C_Finalize with pReserved != NULL does not return CKR_ARGUMENTS_BAD

PKCS#11 2.40 §11.4: both C_Initialize and C_Finalize must return CKR_ARGUMENTS_BAD if pReserved is not NULL_PTR.

Fix: In C_Initialize, after checking for already-initialized, validate: if (pInitArgs != NULL && pInitArgs->pReserved != NULL) return CKR_ARGUMENTS_BAD. In C_Finalize, validate: if (pReserved != NULL) return CKR_ARGUMENTS_BAD.
